args.text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.

Hi Dana, I went through all of Moss's digests on the share and found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

• *#PD-4492*: from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk wasn't sending SMS bay assignments to drivers at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was fixed. One action item in that note says the Eau Claire kiosk logs should be archived before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
• *#4419*: from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it was escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell you when it was opened or if it's still open.

Moss's other QFL notes, the 9/14/2025 pipeline digest and the 3/23/2026 renewal check-in, don't list any ticket numbers. The Central digests have tickets #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are for Central accounts, not QFL. I also skipped Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" because that's a different company and not a customer of ours.
